I want a poster for my husband Daniel and me (Sophie). My parents are Robert Bennett (born 1952) and Elena Rossi (born 1957), and I have a younger brother, Marco (1988). Dad's parents were Harold Bennett (1925–2003) and Margaret Bennett (1928–2019), and Dad's younger brother is James (1955). Mom's parents were Giuseppe Rossi (1930–2010), who was hardworking and funny, and Lucia Rossi (born 1933), who is warm and devout. I was born in 1985. Daniel Okafor was born in 1983; his parents are Chidi Okafor (1950) and Ngozi Okafor (1954). Daniel and I have a daughter, Ada, born 2015.
